{{Quote|It was foolish to dink te droidtechs would reveal anydin', but dey sparkin' a dought. Find da toolkit usin' by da droidtechs, and mesa'll bet wesa find da password.|Boss Nass, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:US" />}}
The '''Ultragungan Droidtech Camp''' was a ruined building located in the [[Lasay Swamp]] of the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the building was used as a camp by the droidtechs of the [[Ultragungans|Ultragungan Militia]].<ref name="SWG:US" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to the camp in order to retrieve an Ultragungan droidtech toolkit. In the toolkit, the spacer found a password allowing to bypass the self-destruct security mechanism of the Ultragungan [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].<ref name="SWG:US" />
